title: Elisa debugger DAP launch configuration
description: VS Code-style debug configuration for the current Elisa DAP adapter. The adapter consumes program, optional sourcePathRoot, and optional elisaVirtualFiles from DAP launch arguments when the matching capability is advertised; other editor configuration fields are accepted by the schema but do not change target execution.

type.description: The debugger type registered by the plugin author.

program.description: Path to a complete EDIR artifact. The adapter validates the file contents; it does not compile Elisa source or require a particular filename extension.

sourcePathRoot.description: Optional absolute POSIX, Windows drive, or UNC workspace root used to map source paths. The adapter validates and normalizes the root before matching EDIR logical paths.

elisaVirtualFiles.description: Optional version 1 managed EDIR launch snapshots. Use only when initialize advertises supportsElisaVirtualFiles version 1. Handles must be contiguous from 1 in array order.

handle.description: Explicit guest virtual-file handle; handles must be 1 through N in array order.

path.description: Logical resource identity; the adapter does not open this path on the host.

contentsHex.description: Binary-safe initial contents encoded as up to 256 hexadecimal byte pairs.

writable.description: Optional and currently read-only; true is rejected until guest write operations are supported.
